integrity: Proof is self-contained except for standard stars-and-bars counting, elementary weak convergence of uniform subsets, and Dirichlet spacing moments. The finite checker is supporting evidence, not an infinite proof or independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Only three-divisible cycle lengths, positive fixed scaling coefficient and fixed Fourier-index offsets; full-spectrum and dynamical scattering questions are not addressed. Historical priority remains provisional.
title: Critical cubic-fugacity Bragg profiles for length-three hard rods on a cycle
